standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo aamma kikkulluunniit toqusimasut pillugit, taakku Kristusip qaamanerani eqqissinermik nassaassapput.
Kikkulluunniit aliasuttut pillugit, Guutip taakku tuppallissavai neriunermillu tunissavai.
spiritual_communion: Jeesusi, upperivassi illit sakramenti illernartumi najuuttutit. Asavassi tamatigut, kissaatigaaralu ilinnut peqataassallunga. Massakkut ilinnut sakramenti tigusinnaanngikkaluarlunga, uummammi ilinnut tikilluaqqujassivassi. Illit ilinnut attuumassuteqarpunga, aamma illit uannut attuumassuteqarputit. Naalagaq, akuerisinnaanngisaannarniarpunga ilinnit avissaartissallunga.
closing: Guutip kissaatigaa ilissi illersussallugit. Eqqissineq ilissinniissaaq.

readings.label: Atuffaat siulleq
readings.text:
Uanga, Johannesi, takuara inngili qilammit aqqartoq, assammini itersap matuersaataa aamma saffiugassamik nunaqarluni. Aalerpaa bue, naapertuilluartoq, tassa Diaabuli imaluunniit Saatanili, aamma parnaarpaa ukiunut tusindinut, itersamullu igilluni, matullugu aamma matuersaarlugu, taamaalilluni naakut nunaqarfinnik siammarterisinnaajunnaarlugit ukiut tusindit naassappata. Taassuma kingorna, sivikitsumik aniguisinneqassaaq.

Taava takuakka issiaviit; kikkut taakkunani issiasut eqqartuussinermik tunineqarput. Aamma takuakka taakkua toqusimasut, Jeesusimik upperniillutik aamma Guutip oqaasianik, aamma kikkut uumasumik imaluunniit taassuma assilineranik pallorfiginninngitsut, imaluunniit taassuma ilisarnaataanik niaqquminni imaluunniit assamminni tigusinngitsut. Uummarput aamma Kristusimik ukiunut tusindinut naalakkersuillutik.

Kingorna takuara issiavik qaqortoq angisooq aamma kikkut taassuma saavani issiasut. Nunarsuaq aamma qilak taassuma saavanit qimaapput aamma najugaqarfissaqanngillat. Takuakka toqusimasut, angisuut aamma mikisuut, issiaviup saavaniittut, aamma allattorsimaffiit ammarneqarput. Taava allattorsimaffik alla ammarneqarpoq, inuunerup atuagaa. Toqusimasut eqqartuunneqarput iliuuserisatik malillugit, allattorsimaffinni allassimasut malillugit. Immap toqusimasuni tunniuppai; taava Toqu aamma Hades toqusimasuni tunniuppai. Toqusimasut tamarmik eqqartuunneqarput iliuuserisatik malillugit. Taava Toqu aamma Hades ikuallaffimmut iginneqarput. (Taanna ikuallaffik tassaavoq toqu aappaat.) Kinaluunniit ateq inuunerup atuagaani nassaarineqanngitsoq ikuallaffimmut iginneqarpoq.

Taava takuara qilak nutaaq aamma nunarsuaq nutaaq. Qilak siulleq aamma nunarsuaq siulleq qaangiussimapput, aamma imaq peqqujunnaarpoq. Aamma takuara illoqarfik illernartoq, Jerusalem nutaaq, qilammit Guutimit aqqartoq, nuliaasutut aappassaminut atisalerluni piareersimasoq.

readings.label: Evangelium
readings.text: Jeesusip ajoqersukkani oqaluttuuppai oqaluttuatut. 'Isiginiarisi kussuk aamma orpiit allat tamarmik. Naasut ammarpat, takusarpisi aamma nalunngilluinnarpisi aasivik qanillisoq; taamatuttaaq, iliuuserisat taakkua takugussigit, nalunngilluinnarisi Guutip naalagaaffia qanillisoq. Amen, oqarfigissavassi, kinguaariit taakkua qaangiutissapput tamarmik taakkua pisimasut piffissani taakkunani. Qilak aamma nunarsuaq qaangiutissapput, kisiannili oqaasikka qaangiutissanngillat.'

day: Friday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Sad
pet_prayers.text: Miss you kid! We are in Taiwan right now. Thinking of you everywhere we go. Mom cries almost every day over here

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
